sourceAnchors.message: Ensure that resources like this ExecutorService object are closed after use
sourceAnchors.reason: Executor ownership ends in a bounded finally with shutdownNow and ten second termination. Implicit close would allow waiting without a deadline.

sourceAnchors.message: To be compliant to J2EE, a webapp should not use any thread.
sourceAnchors.reason: Only finite local unit test fixture threads are used; Future.get and executor release are bounded and there is no application or service thread.
